name: Exp_CronexRSI
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the CronexRSI custom indicator, which applies fast and slow smoothing to RSI values. It opens buy positions when the fast RSI line crosses above the slow signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by a money management module with multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexRSI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对RSI值应用快速和慢速平滑处理。当快速RSI线上穿慢速信号线时开多仓，反向交叉时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。仓位大小通过多种保证金模式的资金管理模块控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CronexRSI指标的双线交叉，本质上是对RSI进行两次不同周期的平滑处理后再判断动量方向变化。入场条件为：当快速平滑RSI线（Ind）从下方穿越慢速信号线（Sign）时产生买入信号，当快速线从上方穿越慢速信号线时产生卖出信号，交叉确认需要两根K线的对比。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓、固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit设置。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数五种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。该策略在H4周期上运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线进行信号判断，避免未来数据偷看问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual-line crossover of the CronexRSI indicator, which essentially applies two different-period smoothing algorithms to RSI values to detect momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast smoothed RSI line (Ind) crosses above the slow signal line (Sign), and a sell signal on the reverse crossover, requiring two bars for crossover confirmation. Exit conditions include: opposite crossover signals trigger position closing, and fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) settings. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 risk ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 meaning it evaluates the previous closed bar for signals, avoiding look-ahead bias.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lots)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平空）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy to close position (reverse signal closes short)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平多）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell to close position (reverse signal closes long)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 使用SignalBar=1基于已收盘K线判断信号，避免未来数据偷看和重绘问题
支持多种资金管理模式和灵活的买卖开平仓开关，适应不同交易需求
采用IsNewBar机制控制信号计算频率，减少冗余计算和重复交易
止损止盈设置合理，止盈大于止损（1:2风险回报比）
指标句柄检查和BarsCalculated验证确保指标数据可用后才进行交易
pros_en: Uses SignalBar=1 to evaluate signals on closed bars, avoiding look-ahead bias and repainting issues
Supports multiple money management modes and flexible buy/sell open/close switches for different trading needs
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to control signal calculation frequency, reducing redundant computation and duplicate trades
Reasonable stop loss and take profit settings with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Indicator handle validation and BarsCalculated check ensure indicator data is available before trading
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值未根据市场波动率动态调整，在不同品种和周期上可能不适用
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在同一方向重复开仓导致仓位叠加
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高位差品种上可能因滑点造成不必要的亏损
CronexRSI为自定义指标，存在依赖性，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利交易
cons_en: Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP are not dynamically adjusted for market volatility, potentially unsuitable across different instruments and timeframes
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction leading to overexposure
Lacks spread filter, which may cause unnecessary losses due to slippage on high-spread instruments
CronexRSI is a custom indicator creating a dependency - the EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
No trading time filter, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，或在开仓前检查是否已有同向持仓
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损止盈距离
增加点差过滤和时间过滤机制，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction positions, or verify existing positions before opening new ones
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt SL/TP distances to market volatility
Add spread filter and time filter mechanisms to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity sessions

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向仓位叠加，风险敞口超出预期
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在高波动时止损可能过小导致频繁止损
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下信号可能被噪声触发
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may lead to overlapping same-direction positions, exceeding expected risk exposure
Fixed SL/TP does not account for market volatility - stop loss may be too tight during high volatility causing frequent stops
No spread filter means signals may be triggered by noise in high-spread environments
